changes.summary: Payment period extended from 30 days to 60 days.
changes.sent_excerpt: Customer shall pay each invoice within thirty (30) days of the invoice date.
changes.signed_excerpt: Customer will pay each invoice within 60 days of the invoice date.

changes.summary: Liability cap doubled from 1x to 2x fees paid in the preceding twelve months.
changes.sent_excerpt: shall not exceed 1x the fees paid by Customer in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.
changes.signed_excerpt: will not exceed 2x the fees paid by Customer in the 12 months preceding the claim.

changes.summary: Auto-renewal clause removed entirely from the signed agreement.
changes.sent_excerpt: This Agreement shall renew automatically for successive twelve (12) month terms unless either party gives sixty (60) days written notice.

changes.summary: Customer gained a unilateral right to terminate for convenience on 90 days' written notice.
changes.sent_excerpt: Neither party may terminate this Agreement for convenience.
changes.signed_excerpt: Customer may also terminate this Agreement for convenience on 90 days written notice.
